subject: math
description: Identify vertical, adjacent, linear pair, and supplementary angles, then use those relationships to solve missing-angle equations.
learningObjectives: Identify adjacent angles that share a vertex and a common side
Identify vertical angles formed by intersecting lines
Recognize linear pairs and explain why their measures add to 180 degrees
Recognize supplementary angles and use their sum to find missing measures
Solve missing-angle equations using angle-pair relationships
prerequisites: Classify acute, right, obtuse, and straight angles
Write complete angle statements such as m∠ABC = 75°
Solve one-step equations such as x + 40 = 180
